extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: classic motorcycle (cafe racer), approx. 2.0 x 0.8 x 1.2 m (L x W x H), 18 in spoked wheels
extras.notes: front faces -Y; stands upright on its center stand; wheels are separate objects with origin on the axle (rotate around local X to roll); motorcycle_steering (fork, triple clamps, handlebar, mirrors, gauges, headlight, front fender) has its origin on the steering axis, which is tilted 26 deg: rotate around the axis (0, 0.438, 0.899) in Blender Z-up coordinates = (0, 0.899, -0.438) in glTF Y-up, steering lock about +-28 deg (turn the front wheel about the same axis and pivot); no brand, no text, blank license plate

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
